status.evidence: According to Companies House records, ITRACKING LTD (Company number 06542959) was originally registered at Coleford, Gloucestershire, before changing its office to Newton Abbot, and its status remains active as of 2026.

claims.claim: The company serves as an official sales and installation partner for Webfleet (formerly TomTom Telematics), utilizing their core tracking infrastructure to matching fleet requirements as documented in the Webfleet Sales Partner Directory.

ITracking Limited has partnered with MANTIS to deploy their connected camera video telematics systems, ensuring seamless integration with third-party software platforms like Webfleet to provide fleet analytics, as reported on the iTracking MANTIS Partnership Update.
As a premium partner of Webfleet, the company installs and integrates tracking, camera, and sensor equipment into unified systems for fleets across the South West of England and Wales.
A public spending record from Hampshire County Council shows a transaction of £789.95 paid to iTracking Limited on 1 August 2026 for vehicle workshop spares and services.
The company operates as a Webfleet premium partner to supply integrated fleet management systems and commercial tracking solutions, as stated on the official iTracking website.

The company is designated as a Webfleet Premium Sales Partner in the UK, operating primarily as a regional service provider supplying third-party telematics and fleet management solutions to business fleets in Bristol, the West Country, and South Wales, according to the official Webfleet Partner Directory.

claims.note: The statement 'Not available Webfleet +1' contains unconfirmed/unclear text with no corresponding factual details in published company records.

claims.claim: The company reports that its local operations are conducted by a micro-sized team of under 10 employees.
